<?php
namespace Review148Model {
    class Base {
        public int $number = 5;
        public function __construct() { echo "ctor|"; }
    }
    interface Read {}
}
namespace Review148Caller {
    use Review148Model\Base as CallerBase;
    echo "before|";
    try { eval('$bad = new class extends CallerBase {};'); }
    catch (\Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|"; }
    eval('namespace Review148Eval; use Review148Model\Base as LocalBase; use Review148Model\Read as LocalRead; $good = new class extends LocalBase implements LocalRead { public ?LocalBase $ref = null; };');
    $good->ref = $good;
    echo $good::class, "|", $good->number, "|", ($good->ref === $good ? "typed" : "bad");
}

<?php
class Review148RootBase {}
$seed = new class {};
echo $seed::class, "|";
eval('namespace Review148Counter; use Review148RootBase as ExternalBase; class Named extends ExternalBase {} $inside = new class extends Named {}; echo $inside::class, "|";');
eval('$tail = new class {}; echo $tail::class;');

<?php
$attempt148 = 0;
function review148Load($name) {
    global $attempt148;
    echo "load:", $name, "|";
    if ($name === 'Review148Loaded\Base') {
        eval('namespace Review148Loaded; class Base { public function __construct() { echo "ctor|"; } }');
    } elseif ($name === 'Review148Loaded\Read') {
        $attempt148++;
        if ($attempt148 === 1) { throw new Exception("pause"); }
        eval('namespace Review148Loaded; interface Read {}');
    }
}
spl_autoload_register('review148Load');
eval('namespace Review148Retry; use Review148Loaded\Base as ParentAlias; use Review148Loaded\Read as InterfaceAlias; $round = 0; $previous = null; while ($round < 3) { $round++; try { $current = new class extends ParentAlias implements InterfaceAlias { public int $number = 9; }; echo $current::class, "|", $current->number, "|"; if ($previous !== null) { echo $previous::class === $current::class ? "same|" : "bad|"; echo $previous !== $current ? "fresh|" : "bad|"; } $previous = $current; } catch (\Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|"; } }');

<?php
interface Read148Root { public function value(): int; }
class Base148Root { public int $number = 6; public function value(): int { return $this->number; } }
function unused148($value) { return $value; }
$closure148 = static function($value) { return $value; };
$arrow148 = static fn($value) => $value;
$first148 = new class {};
eval('$next148 = new class extends Base148Root implements Read148Root {};');
echo $first148::class, '|', $next148::class, '|', $next148->value(), '|', $next148 instanceof Read148Root ? 'read' : 'bad';

<?php
namespace Vendor148Include {
    interface Read { public function value(): int; }
    class Base { public int $number = 5; public function value(): int { return $this->number; } }
}
namespace Caller148Include {
    use Wrong148\Space as ParentAlias;
    include __DIR__ . '/payload.php';
    include_once __DIR__ . '/payload.php';
    echo '|once';
}

while ($i148 < 2) {

    if ($i148 === 0) { $first148 = $x148; }
    else { echo $first148 !== $x148 ? 'fresh' : 'bad', '|', $first148::class === $x148::class ? 'same' : 'bad', '|', $x148->value(), '|', $x148::class; }
    $i148++;
